scripts.translation: 因為帕阿很善良，喵。所以我來給你講個故事，喵。

scripts.text: Ser cat is my twin brother. I was born first, but he always says he is the elder meow. But, I don't fight with Ser meow. I am a good brother meow.
scripts.translation: 塞爾是我的雙胞胎弟弟。我先出生，可他總說自己才是哥哥，喵。不過我從不和塞爾爭，喵。我是個好哥哥，喵。

scripts.text: Anyways, me and Ser are well known as the pro gamer cat brothers meow. Everyone knows us meow.
scripts.translation: 總之，我和塞爾可是有名的職業玩家兄弟，喵。大家都認識我們，喵。

scripts.text: You are free to admire me, meow. I give you permission meow.
scripts.translation: 你可以盡情崇拜我，喵。我准許了，喵。

scripts.text: You want to know how to play this game meow? I'll teach you because I am a kind cat meow~

scripts.text: You don't seem that stupid meow. So, let's skip the part about what beats what meow.

scripts.text: You must play 5 matches with me meow. We go again if the game is even meow.

scripts.text: If you win 3 times, I'll give you a present meow~ Cat Gamers Director said so meow.

scripts.text: That is all meow~ But it is not an easy game meow. Respect the game meow~

scripts.text: Result is even, so we play again meow.
scripts.translation: 喵。平局了，所以我們再比一次，

scripts.text: Meow!! All 5 matches are over meow!!

scripts.text: Just take it meow!! Do as I say meow~

scripts.text: What? Present meow? How can you ask for such a thing meow? You lost meow! Go practice more!! Work!! Yes, I should make you do this meow!!

scripts.text: Paa wipes the drool from his mouth.

scripts.text: Now it's time for some healthy food meow.

scripts.text: Get 50 Marse and 25 Milk to our Cat Gamers Director meow. He has excellent knowledge on healthy foods meow.

scripts.text: Then, we shall find out if our manager is being greedy or not meow.
scripts.translation: 這樣就能查出我們的管理員是不是在貪便宜了，喵。

scripts.translation: 我最近狀態不太好，比賽時總是發揮不出全部實力，喵。

scripts.translation: 這種時候就需要檸檬，喵。

scripts.translation: 綿綿島很適合貓咪生活，喵。不過比賽時會熱得受不了，喵。

scripts.text: Ok, let's practice until a challenger comes!!
scripts.translation: 好，我們就練習到有挑戰者來為止！！

scripts.text: You cannot challenge this Flag Game unless you are wearing our certificate item. Please come back later.
scripts.translation: 必須裝備我們的證書才能挑戰奪旗遊戲，請之後再來。

scripts.text: The Flag Game is only available once a day.
scripts.translation: 奪旗遊戲一天只能參加一次。

scripts.text: Let's challenge the Flag Game. Please wait while our cats get prepared.
scripts.translation: 來挑戰奪旗遊戲吧。請稍等，我們的貓咪正在準備。

scripts.text: Oh! I retired from 'Cat Gamers', and am working on a national game referee license. Licenses are the new trend these days.
scripts.translation: 哦！我已經退出“貓玩家”了，現在正在考國家級遊戲裁判證。最近考證很流行。

scripts.text: A referee must use standard language... So it was very hard for me to stop crying meow meow~ like other cats.
scripts.translation: 裁判必須使用標準用語......所以我很難像其他貓那樣喵喵叫。

scripts.text: I know the game rules for players for sure, but refereeing the game is a lot harder than it seems.
scripts.translation: 我當然懂選手要遵守的規則，但當裁判可比看起來難多了。

scripts.text: Sometimes I do make mistakes, and people go crazy like it's the end of world. What a hard job this is.
scripts.translation: 有時我也會犯錯，大家卻像天塌了一樣鬧起來。這工作真不容易。

scripts.text: But, I want to finish this course, and be the world's best referee ever.
scripts.translation: 不過我想完成這門課程，成為有史以來最出色的裁判。

scripts.text: Allow me to explain the rule for the Flag-Waving Game.
scripts.translation: 讓我來說明奪旗遊戲的規則。
你會和另外五隻貓一起比

scripts.text: Wait and wave the flag when no others are waving it.
scripts.translation: 賽。等其他貓都沒揮旗時，再揮動你的旗子。

scripts.text: You start with 5 Flag Points, and each time you wave the flag 1 point vanishes.
scripts.translation: 開始時你有五點旗分，每揮一次旗就會扣一點。

scripts.text: When your points hit 0, the game ends.
There's a special rule for this Flag Game. For more thrill, we reduce 1 point if you do not wave your flag for 10 games.
scripts.translation: 奪旗遊戲還有一條特別規則：為了增加刺激感，如果連續十局不揮旗，就會扣一點旗分。

scripts.text: You will get bigger presents as you win with less Flag Points used.
scripts.translation: 獲勝時剩下的旗分越多，獎品就越豐厚。

scripts.text: Come back anytime if you need more help with the game rules. Our Manager Cat is also available for some help with the game rules.
scripts.translation: 如果還想了解遊戲規則，隨時可以回來問我。貓管理員也能為你解答。
貓咪們都準備好了。你要做什麼

scripts.text: You have used all your Flag Points.
You have failed at flag waving.
Let's move on to the next game.
Congrats {0}. You have succeed on not waving your flag.
scripts.translation: 恭喜，。你成功忍住沒揮旗。 {0}

scripts.text: But! This is flag waving game, so this doesn't count.
scripts.translation: 但是！這是揮旗遊戲，這樣可不算贏。

scripts.text: Since you didn't wave your flag for 10 games, 1 Flag Point will be reduced according to the official Flag Game rules.
scripts.translation: 根據官方奪旗規則，你連續十局沒有揮旗，要扣除一點旗分。

scripts.text: You have used all your Flag Points.
Game {0} has ended properly. Point penalty will be given after {1} more.
scripts.translation: 第局順利結束。再過局就會扣分。 {0}{1}

scripts.text: Let's move on to the next game.
After {0} games, {1} has {2} Flag Point left.
Congratulations. You have won the Flag-Waving Game.
scripts.translation: 恭喜你贏得了奪旗遊戲。

scripts.text: But, only 3 Canned Foods will be given as the present since you didn't take a big part through the game.
scripts.translation: 不過你在比賽中沒怎麼參與，所以獎品只有3罐罐頭食品。

scripts.text: Congratulations. You have won the Flag-Waving Game. {0} Canned Foods will be given as the present.
scripts.translation: 恭喜你贏得了奪旗遊戲。獎品是罐罐頭食品。 {0}

scripts.text: Hope you win some more Canned Foods tomorrow.
scripts.translation: 希望你明天還能贏到更多罐頭。

scripts.text: Leader gives you a note without hesitation. You must follow the order now.
scripts.translation: 首領毫不猶豫地遞給你一張紙條。現在你只能照辦了。

scripts.text: Ah~ I'm hungry. Any rats wandering around?
scripts.translation: 啊～我餓了。附近有老鼠嗎？

scripts.text: Ah~ I think I could eat 100 cramps at once.
scripts.translation: 啊～我覺得一口氣能吃下一百隻藍鼠。

scripts.text: Hey, why don't you look around? Who knows? Maybe we can find a delicious canned food~
scripts.translation: 喂，四處找找看吧。說不定能找到好吃的罐頭呢～

scripts.text: Then, you can give me one. Hehe~
scripts.translation: 到時候分我一罐吧。嘿嘿～

scripts.text: I am hungry~ Any leftover canned food there?
scripts.translation: 我餓了～還有剩下的罐頭嗎？

scripts.text: Hut! Human, you came to see me, Row the Great? What? No?
scripts.translation: 嘿！人類，你是來看偉大的羅的嗎？什麼？不是？

scripts.text: What do want then? Get lost. Ah...!!
You want to play the Flag Game? I see. Show me what you've got.
scripts.translation: 想玩奪旗嗎？知道了，讓我看看你的本事。

scripts.text: But, you know you can never beat me, the great Row.
scripts.translation: 不過你知道吧？你絕不可能贏過偉大的羅。

scripts.text: Flag waving is a serious game. Only special cats like me can compete. Meow~
scripts.translation: 奪旗可是很認真的比賽。只有我這樣的特別貓咪才有資格參加，喵～

scripts.text: Hair picking is my best hobby meow.
scripts.translation: 拔毛是我最喜歡的消遣，喵。

scripts.text: Come here, you, meow. I'll pick your hair meow.
scripts.translation: 過來，喵。我來幫你拔毛，喵。

scripts.text: The cat is picking your hair.
Arrgg!! Why should I play this stupid flag waving game here?
scripts.translation: 啊啊！！我為什麼要在這裡玩這種蠢透了的奪旗遊戲？

scripts.text: Hey you. What do you think? I know you've hearing me!
scripts.translation: 喂，你在想什麼？我知道你一直在聽！

scripts.text: Well, I'm sure you won't have a clue why this is happening. I forgive you.
scripts.translation: 我猜你也不明白這是怎麼回事。算了，我原諒你。

scripts.text: How can a human understand the overwhelming heart of cats.
scripts.translation: 人類怎麼可能理解貓咪那顆強烈的心呢？

scripts.text: A human? What are you doing here?
Oh! I see. Our director is looking a practicing partner, why don't you apply?
scripts.translation: 哦，原來如此。協會負責人正在找練習搭檔，你怎麼不去報名？

scripts.text: What are you, a dog? Meow~!
Do not mess with the drooping cat.
scripts.translation: 別去招惹那隻無精打采的貓。

scripts.text: There are more orders coming every day. Ahh!! Give me some more manpower!!
scripts.translation: 每天都有更多訂單。啊啊！！再多給我派些人手吧！！

scripts.text: Please... Keep this wherever you go.

scripts.text: I am a cat. Nyah~ Ong~
I look like a sheep because I was so busy I didn't have time to shave.

scripts.translation: ”。不過協會負責人好像很忙，我要不要直接走掉？

scripts.text: The Cat Gamers Director did that?
scripts.translation: 貓玩家協會負責人乾的嗎？

scripts.text: Maybe I should rethink joining 'Cat Gamers', huh?
scripts.translation: 是不是該重新考慮要不要加入“貓玩家”？

scripts.translation: 你的物品帶得太多了，請整理後再來！

If you have an Archangel Wing, I will enchant my capability into the useless 4th slot. Would you like me to do so?
